messages.author: 3a42213e2dc51134
messages.subject: Having trouble getting development version
parts:
Good morning,

I am unable to install the development version of ggvis. Using the commands from the github page:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("hadley/lazy", build_vignettes = FALSE)
devtools::install_github("hadley/dplyr", build_vignettes = FALSE)
devtools::install_github("rstudio/ggvis", build_vignettes = FALSE)

Produces this error:

Warning: running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.1/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.1/share/make/winshlib.mk" SHLIB="lazyeval.dll" WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="lazy.o"' had status 127
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'lazyeval'
* removing 'C:/Users/abryk/Documents/R/win-library/3.1/lazyeval'
Error: Command failed (1)

This creates a dependency issue in the dplyr install

ERROR: dependency 'lazyeval' is not available for package 'dplyr'
* removing 'C:/Users/abryk/Documents/R/win-library/3.1/dplyr'
Error: Command failed (1)

Which creates a dependency issue in the ggvis install

 namespace 'dplyr' 0.2 is being loaded, but >= 0.2.0.99 is required
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package 'ggvis'
* removing 'C:/Users/abryk/Documents/R/win-library/3.1/ggvis'
Error: Command failed (1)

Any help is appreciated!

Thanks,
Andrew

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Having trouble getting development version
parts:
Do you have rtools installed? If so, try doing library(devtools)
before the other lines of code (this is a bug in devtools)

Hadley
